item.title: AI and Responsible Management Education
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines the intersection of artificial intelligence and responsible management education. The issue seeks submissions exploring how AI technologies can be integrated into management education while maintaining ethical standards and promoting responsible practices in business schools and management programs.

Appel publié par Organizational Behavior Teaching Review. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • AI in management education
  • Responsible management education
  • Artificial intelligence applications in education

Timeline

  • April 1, 2027: Submissions open
  • June 1, 2027: Submissions close
